rules.title: King County algorithmic rent-pricing chapter: renter remedies
rules.requirement: King County Code ch. 12.23 regulates algorithmic rent pricing. Injured renters may seek actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation, and attorney fees. The captured source does not describe the prohibited conduct, the covered software or the covered buildings.
rules.key_value: Actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation, plus attorney fees

coverage.summary: The captured source does not state which buildings, landlords or geographic areas are covered.

rules.effective_date_note: The only source, a secondary law-firm alert, says 'effective October 2025' and gives no day. The exact date is unverified.
rules.quoted_span: Injured renters may seek actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation and attorney fees.
rules.review_note: The only support is one row of a summary table in a secondary law-firm alert (Morgan Lewis, Aug. 21, 2026). No official text of King County Code ch. 12.23 was captured. The prohibited conduct, definitions, section-level citation, ordinance number, coverage and the geographic area within King County (for example, unincorporated areas only versus countywide) cannot be verified. Seattle's separate ordinance (Seattle Mun. Code ch. 7.34) is city-level and is not part of this county record. Obtain the official code text before relying on this record.
